properties.name: A premise has a truth, a counter-argument is its own statement, and a correct proof reads correct
properties.rationale: Built for req:the-records-a-choice-rests-on-carry-a-truth-and-a-counter-argument-is-its-own-statement and req:a-correct-proof-reads-correct-assumptions-objections-and-conditional-claims (Anthony, 2026-10-18), from the proof of concept's case 1 and the π+e, Arrow and Brocard trials. Cause: fact:root-cause-a-truth-computed-for-the-walk-was-served-to-the-reader-and-reasoning-was-told-by-inference-edges-alone-2026-10-18 (run as the root-cause skill). Choices made: (1) a finding's basis counts — measured holds, forecast is unknown, unstated reads measured as the schema default does; confidence changes nothing. (2) The counter-argument representation is a Requirement with statement_kind and an opposing CONTRADICTS, no new type, so the schema stamp does not move; the proof of concept's chg→dec objection and its ver→chg reply were re-expressed that way on reflow2's live design (req:objection-a-cross-type-near-match-note-trades-a-false-alarm-for-a-silent-miss), and the two PoC CONTRADICTS edges deleted. (3) A standing objection is "deliberate" only when it states its reason in evidence, which keeps the 2026-10-17 pin a_contradiction_between_two_unknown_claims_is_still_reported; a mutual attack or an odd cycle reads contested in reasoning_report and is a defect only while unargued. Twelve class tests over six designs; ten observed failing on main c9e6ca4 first. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Phase 1 of the 2026-10-18 build list. A measured, standing TemporalFact holds as a premise (forecast, ended or invalidated reads unknown). A ChangeEvent is history and never reads false; a counter-argument is a statement of its own. An accepted Decision a step concludes holds on its acceptance with the chain's verdict beside it (reasoning_report acceptance/chain, walk accepted_without_a_holding_chain) and says its chose. The served skills agree a Decision may be a chain's conclusion. reasoning_report lists no discharged assumption as unsupported and reads a conditional claim `truth: conditional`. In a line of reasoning an answered objection, or a standing one that states its reason, is swept.suppressed_as_objection instead of a contradiction.
